title: orbitopt mission handoff state (HandoffState v1)
description: The state one mission segment hands to the next (M-01, Epic #215): epoch with its timescale, frame, position, velocity, wet mass, the stage configuration attached, and free-form metadata. Epochs are MJD2000 day-labels counted on the declared timescale (each day exactly 86400 SI seconds, the convention of orbitopt.timescales); comparisons always go through Epoch.to_tdb_seconds(). Structural rules JSON Schema can express live here; finiteness, mass > 0 and epoch representability are checked by orbitopt.mission.contract.state_from_dict, matching the scene_format split. Compatibility policy: readers ignore unknown OPTIONAL fields, so adding one is not a breaking change; removing/renaming/narrowing is, and gets handoff-state-2.0.json.

epoch.description: Mission instant: MJD2000 day-labels plus the timescale they are counted on. The timescale is mandatory -- a TT epoch is never treated as UTC.

mjd2000.description: Days since 2000-01-01 00:00:00 on the declared timescale's own day label (86400 SI s per day, like datetime; leap seconds are not counted inside the day).

frame.description: One of the package's Flight Lab v1 frames; GCRS is the recommended interchange frame. Never label a backend's private pseudo-ECI 'GCRS' -- convert via orbitopt.flightlab.frames inside the producing segment.

mass_kg.description: Wet mass of the remaining stack [kg], including everything the stage_config says is still attached.

stage_config.description: Opaque-to-the-contract description of the stage configuration at this handoff (e.g. which vehicle/stage/engines are active). A change of this mapping between consecutive states is what makes a beyond-tolerance mass drop legal (staging/shedding); with an unchanged stage_config, mass is conserved.

metadata.description: Free-form producer annotations (solver provenance, run ids, ...). Optional; readers must not depend on any particular key.

vec3.description: Three finite numbers (finiteness enforced by orbitopt.mission.contract).
